questions.question: Light waves can be polarised. This provides evidence that light waves are what kind of waves?
How is light reflected at the polarising angle?

answers.a: Polarised parallel to the reflecting surface
answers.b: Polarised parpendicular to the reflecting surface
answers.c: Polarised parallel and perpendicular to the reflecting surface
answers.d: Polarised in the direction in which the wave is travelling

questions.question: Which among the following shows the transverse wave nature of light?

answers.a: Diffraction of light through a single slit
answers.b: Interference of light in a thin soap film
answers.c: Polarisation of light through selective absorption
answers.d: Refraction of light through a glass plate
